description: Records one state of a Task. Only `task` and `run` have writers yet; the other dimensions answer `dimension_not_enabled`, and `review` or `approval_marker` from a runtime or system actor answer `human_actor_required`.

actorKind.description: Supplied by the desktop main process, never by the renderer: `human` (the bound principal), `runtime` or `system`.

actorRef.description: The runtime or host name for a `runtime` or `system` actor; must be absent for `human`, whose reference is the bound principal.

expectedRevision.description: The Task's state revision as last read (0 before the first record).

title: InquelloStateRecordParams
